interacts.title: Reception
interacts.text: Welcome to Duel Academy! The Grand Duel Arena is straight ahead, the Card Shop is on your right.

interacts.title: Card Shop
interacts.text: Booster packs, fresh from the mainland! Trade, buy and build your deck.

interacts.title: Grand Duel Arena
interacts.text: Step onto the field to start a holographic duel!

interacts.title: Academy Island Directions
interacts.text: N: Duel Academy, Girls' Dorm & Lake  |  NE: Volcano, Hot Springs  |  E: Forest, Abandoned Dorm (off limits!)  |  NW: Obelisk Blue Dorm  |  W: Slifer Red Dorm, West Cliffs  |  SW: Ra Yellow Dorm  |  S: Harbor, Lighthouse, Heliport  |  SE: Beach & Duel Gym

interacts.title: Slifer Red Dorm
interacts.text: Home of Duel Academy's newest - and most underestimated - duelists. Cheap rooms, curry for dinner, and the best ocean view on the island.

interacts.title: Ra Yellow Dorm
interacts.text: Ra Yellow Dorm - comfortable rooms, a proper cafeteria, and at least one student whose walls are covered in equations.

interacts.title: Duel Salon
interacts.text: Obelisk Blue's private duel salon. Only the elite may sit at these tables - and the losers polish the trophies next door.

interacts.title: Obelisk Blue Dorm
interacts.text: Obelisk Blue Dorm - reserved for the academy's elite. Marble halls, a five-star kitchen and a view worthy of a king.

interacts.title: Obelisk Blue Girls' Dorm
interacts.text: Obelisk Blue Girls' Dorm - boys caught near the lake answer to the Queen of Obelisk Blue.

interacts.title: Fishing Pier
interacts.text: Fishing is allowed after classes. Please take your trash - and your cards - home with you.

interacts.title: Ferry Timetable
interacts.text: The ferry from Domino City arrives every Monday. Welcome to Duel Academy!

interacts.title: Heliport
interacts.text: Visiting pros and VIP guests of the Chancellor land here. Keep clear of the pad!

interacts.title: Duel Academy Harbor
interacts.text: Ferry terminal to the east, warehouses and the heliport to the west. Follow the breakwater to reach the lighthouse.

interacts.title: Lighthouse
interacts.text: A quiet place to think. Some say the Kaiser comes here to watch the sea.

interacts.title: Shadow Duel Field
interacts.text: A duel field drawn in chalk. The candles are still burning... who lit them?

interacts.title: A hidden diary
interacts.text: Under a loose floorboard: a student's diary. The last entry: 'The candles were lit again tonight. Someone keeps calling my name from the old tower. Tomorrow I'll find out who.'

interacts.title: The tower clock
interacts.text: The clock stopped at 12:07 - the night the last students disappeared. Its pendulum hangs still, but something has been oiling the wheels.

interacts.title: Abandoned Dorm
interacts.text: The old Special Dorm. Students who stayed here vanished without a trace... Turn back.

interacts.title: Practice Field
interacts.text: Practice duels welcome!

interacts.title: Practice Field
interacts.text: Practice duels welcome!

interacts.title: Outdoor Practice Court
interacts.text: Duel the practice stands - or a friend!

interacts.title: Outdoor Practice Court
interacts.text: Duel the practice stands - or a friend!

interacts.title: Hot Springs
interacts.text: Water heated by the volcano itself. Relax after a long day of duels.

interacts.title: Duel Academy Volcano
interacts.text: Still active! The crater glows at night and the hot springs below are heated by its magma. Stay behind the railing.

interacts.title: Crater Rim
interacts.text: The top of Duel Academy Volcano. The lava lake below never quite cools - on a still night you can hear it bubble.

interacts.title: Volcano Falls
interacts.text: Spring water warmed by the volcano tumbles into Academy Lake. Legend says duel spirits gather here.

interacts.title: Academy Lake
interacts.text: Fed by Volcano Falls. Rowing boats are available at the girls' dorm jetty - with permission.

interacts.title: Sunset Point
interacts.text: The best sunset on the island. On a clear day you can almost see Domino City.

interacts.title: Beach Duel Court
interacts.text: Sand, sun and a holographic duel. What else do you need?

interacts.title: South-East Beach
interacts.text: White sand and warm water. No duelling in the water, please.

interacts.title: Forest Shrine
interacts.text: A tiny shrine hidden in the woods. Students leave their favourite cards here for luck - some swear the cards whisper back.

interacts.title: Millbrook Mill
interacts.text: The wheel has turned since before the Academy was built. The miller grinds the island's rice flour here - and swears the stones run smoother on duel days.

interacts.title: Millbrook
interacts.text: Millbrook - six hearths, one mill. Flour, firewood and fresh bread for the Academy kitchens. Cross the stone bridge for the campus, follow the lane east for the old dorm (off limits!).

interacts.title: Willow Pond
interacts.text: The Academy River rests here before its last run to the sea. Carp as long as your arm - the villagers say they only bite for duelists who have lost today.

interacts.title: Willow Pond
interacts.text: Willow Pond market: fruit from the terraces, bread from Millbrook's flour, fish from the Cove. Students get a discount if they can name three Field Spell Cards.

interacts.title: Fisher's Cove
interacts.text: Boats go out before dawn and are back for breakfast. The catch feeds all three dorms - the Slifers get the heads, or so they say.

interacts.title: Fisher's Cove
interacts.text: Fisher's Cove: nets, salt and patience. The river brings the fresh water, the tide brings the fish, and the gulls bring opinions.

interacts.title: Academy Classroom
interacts.text: Stage for E02 and the first class beat. Camera at the back wall, teacher at the board.

interacts.title: Academy Exam Room
interacts.text: Written exam UI is A07/A09; this room only supplies the space and marks.

interacts.title: Crowler's Staff Office
interacts.text: Crowler scenes. Desk faces the door; camera over the player's shoulder.

interacts.title: Chancellor Sheppard's Office
interacts.text: Ending/King of Games trigger. Keep a 2 m clear circle around the ending mark.

interacts.title: Slifer Room 101 (Player)
interacts.text: Vertical-slice room. Bed is the sleep/save interaction; keep 1.2 m clear at the door.

interacts.title: Banner's Room
interacts.text: Pharaoh/E14 scenes. Tank is a lit prop anchor; no animal AI in this pass.

interacts.title: Jaden / Syrus / Chumley Bunk Room
interacts.text: E03 and Chumley room beats. Three NPC marks: Jaden, Syrus, Chumley.

interacts.title: Ra Room (Player)
interacts.text: Promotion room. Shares the Slifer room kit with a Ra material swap.

interacts.title: Obelisk Dining Room
interacts.text: Obelisk social/dining scenes. Also serves as the dorm common room.

interacts.title: Obelisk Room (Player)
interacts.text: Promotion room. Material swap on the Ra/Slifer room kit plus marble trim.

zones.name: Duel Academy
zones.subtitle: Main Academy Building
zones.desc: The heart of the island. Classrooms, the card shop and the grand Duel Arena.

zones.name: Academy Plaza
zones.subtitle: Front Courtyard
zones.desc: The fountain courtyard where every freshman takes their first step on campus.

zones.name: Duel Academy Harbor
zones.subtitle: Docks, Warehouse & Heliport
zones.desc: Where the ferry from the mainland arrives. The lighthouse keeps watch at the breakwater.

zones.name: Lighthouse
zones.subtitle: Harbor Breakwater
zones.desc: A quiet place to think. Some say the Kaiser comes here to watch the sea.

zones.name: Slifer Red Dorm
zones.subtitle: Osiris Red Dormitory
zones.desc: Humble, creaky and right on the cliff edge - the best ocean view on the island.

zones.name: Ra Yellow Dorm
zones.subtitle: Ra Yellow Dormitory
zones.desc: Comfortable rooms, a proper cafeteria, and walls covered in someone's equations.

zones.name: Obelisk Blue Dorm
zones.subtitle: Boys' Dormitory
zones.desc: A palace for the elite. Marble columns, fountains and a five-star kitchen.

zones.name: Obelisk Blue Girls' Dorm
zones.subtitle: Lakeside Dormitory
zones.desc: An elegant lakeside mansion. Boys caught near the lake answer to the Queen of Obelisk Blue.

zones.name: Academy Lake
zones.subtitle: Girls' Dorm Lakeshore
zones.desc: Calm water fed by the volcano falls. Rowing boats wait at the jetty.

zones.name: Volcano Falls
zones.subtitle: Lake Waterfall
zones.desc: Snowmelt? No - spring water, warmed by the volcano, tumbling into the lake.

zones.name: Duel Academy Volcano
zones.subtitle: Still Active
zones.desc: The island's smoking heart. The crater glows at night.

zones.name: Abandoned Dorm
zones.subtitle: Off Limits
zones.desc: The old Special Dorm. Students who stayed here vanished. Nobody comes here anymore...

zones.name: Duel Gym
zones.subtitle: Beachside Gymnasium
zones.desc: Sports hall and practice duel courts beyond the beach.

zones.name: South-East Beach
zones.subtitle: White Sand Shore
zones.desc: Warm sand and bright water. Perfect for a beach duel.

zones.name: Hot Springs
zones.subtitle: Volcanic Onsen
zones.desc: Steaming pools heated by the volcano. Relax after a long day of duels.

zones.name: Duel Academy Forest
zones.subtitle: Deep Woods
zones.desc: Dense jungle between the academy and the volcano. Easy to get lost in at night.

zones.name: Millbrook
zones.subtitle: Mill Hamlet on the Academy River
zones.desc: A water mill, a stone bridge and a handful of cottages where the forest path crosses the river.

zones.name: Willow Pond
zones.subtitle: Pondside Village
zones.desc: Thatched cottages, a market square and a jetty on the pond the river fills before the sea.

zones.name: Fisher's Cove
zones.subtitle: Fishing Hamlet at the River Mouth
zones.desc: Net sheds, drying racks and boats pulled up where the Academy River meets the sea.

zones.name: West Cliffs
zones.subtitle: Sunset Point
zones.desc: Sheer cliffs and sea stacks. The sunsets here are legendary.

zones.name: Academy Main Hall
zones.subtitle: Duel Academy
zones.desc: The marble entrance hall: reception, the Duel Disk service desk and the way into the arena.

zones.name: Grand Duel Arena
zones.subtitle: Duel Academy
zones.desc: Floor-level entrance to the arena where every big duel of the year is fought.

zones.name: Card Shop
zones.subtitle: Duel Academy
zones.desc: Booster packs fresh from the mainland, the trading table and Miss Dorothy's counter.

zones.name: Lecture Halls
zones.subtitle: Duel Academy
zones.desc: The west wing: tiered lecture halls, the duelist room and the exam hall upstairs.

zones.name: Academy Library
zones.subtitle: Duel Academy
zones.desc: Third floor of the west wing - rule books, card archives and quiet study tables.

zones.name: Faculty Annex
zones.subtitle: Duel Academy
zones.desc: Behind the arena: the chancellor's office, the teachers' rooms and the staff lounge.

zones.name: Ferry Terminal
zones.subtitle: Duel Academy Harbor
zones.desc: Departure hall, ticket office and the harbor master upstairs.

zones.name: Lighthouse Watch Room
zones.subtitle: Lighthouse
zones.desc: The top of the tower, under the lantern - the whole harbor below.

zones.name: Slifer Dining Hall
zones.subtitle: Slifer Red Dorm
zones.desc: Rice, sardines and Professor Banner's cat. The heart of Slifer Red.

zones.name: Ra Yellow Hall
zones.subtitle: Ra Yellow Dorm
zones.desc: The dorm's entrance hall, with the lounge and the practice duel tables next door.

zones.name: Ra Cafeteria
zones.subtitle: Ra Yellow Dorm
zones.desc: Curry day every day. The best canteen on the island, say the Ra students.

zones.name: Obelisk Grand Foyer
zones.subtitle: Obelisk Blue Dorm
zones.desc: Chandeliers, the twin staircase and a lot of blue.

zones.name: Obelisk Duel Salon
zones.subtitle: Obelisk Blue Dorm
zones.desc: Where the elite practise - duel tables under the portraits of past champions.

zones.name: Girls' Dorm Foyer
zones.subtitle: Obelisk Blue Girls' Dorm
zones.desc: The lakeside mansion's entrance hall. Boys are not welcome.

zones.name: Conservatory
zones.subtitle: Obelisk Blue Girls' Dorm
zones.desc: The glass garden room on the west side, full of flowers and lake light.

zones.name: Abandoned Dorm Hall
zones.subtitle: Abandoned Dorm
zones.desc: Dust, cobwebs and portraits that seem to follow you.

zones.name: Ritual Chamber
zones.subtitle: Abandoned Dorm
zones.desc: The forbidden room below the dorm. The circle on the floor is still warm.

zones.name: Duel Gym Court
zones.subtitle: Duel Gym
zones.desc: The 60 m sports hall: the court, the bleachers, the galleries and the foyer with the lockers and showers.

zones.name: Bathhouse Entrance
zones.subtitle: Hot Springs
zones.desc: Pay at the bandai, then men to the left, women to the right.
